0.0: Long time no see. I heard about your work in Magatia. Crow was really impressed, and that impressed me. He's a hard one to please, but I'm sure I don't have to tell you that.\r\n#L0##b(Crow? Impressed? Me? That's not possible...)#l\n#k
0.1: Just like in Magatia, Mystic Gates have been popping up in Leafre as well. To make matters worse, dark energy is seeping out of them. We need to handle this fast, and you're just the person to lead the charge. Ready to begin?

yes.0: Great. Check out the Mystic Gate in #r#m240010200##k and defeat any monsters you find.

no.0: Talk to me when you're ready. It's urgent.

1.0: You're back. Did you find anything in the Mystic Gate?
1.1: #o9300479#... I heard some monsters escape the gates, given enough time. That could have been a disaster. Thanks for taking care of it.

yes.0: I already sent my report back to HQ. I'm sure they'll have your next mission ready soon, so don't wander off too far.

mob.0: We can't let this dark energy get loose! Things around here REALLY don't like dark energy!
